name: echo-tag
description: Echo Tag — a 3-minute multiplayer browser tag game where your last 3 seconds of movement become a solid obstacle.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @echo-tag/shared && npm run build -w @echo-tag/server && npm run build -w @echo-tag/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run bench:sim
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run size && npm run check:browser
scripts.package: VITE_CHAT=off npm run build && node tools/package/strip-sdk.mjs Echo-Tag-Frontend/dist/index.html crazygames-sdk && cd Echo-Tag-Frontend/dist && rm -f ../../echo-tag-poki.zip && zip -qr ../../echo-tag-poki.zip . -x '*.map' -x '*.br' -x '*.gz' && cd ../.. && echo 'echo-tag-poki.zip (Poki SDK only, chat disabled pending Poki approval):' && du -h echo-tag-poki.zip
scripts.package:web: npm run build && rm -rf .tmp-webdist && cp -R Echo-Tag-Frontend/dist .tmp-webdist && node tools/package/strip-sdk.mjs .tmp-webdist/index.html poki-sdk crazygames-sdk && cd .tmp-webdist && rm -f ../echo-tag-web.zip && zip -qr ../echo-tag-web.zip . -x '*.map' -x '*.br' -x '*.gz' && cd .. && rm -rf .tmp-webdist && echo 'echo-tag-web.zip (portal-neutral, no SDKs):' && du -h echo-tag-web.zip
